unit: NZ$ per m2 of soffit (GST exclusive)

band.unit: NZ$ per m2 of soffit (GST exclusive)
band.centre: Auckland / Wellington (NZ vendor guidance); CHC assumed similar
band.basis: Working cost-plan band, NOT a certified price. Sum of distinct components: licensed specialist removal + containment + disposal ($70-$150/m2, source-1, disposal included so not counted again) + independent assessor clearance/air monitoring ($400-$1,800/job, source-5, converted at an assumed 50 m2 = $8-$36/m2) = $78-$186/m2, rounded to $80-$185/m2; centre ~$130/m2 (mid removal ~$110/m2 + ~$20/m2 assessor). Priced on the stated assumptions: bonded / non-friable cementitious ACM soffit lining, Class B removal, moderate access, single/two-storey, soffit area ~50 m2, containment to the WorkSafe/HSW (Asbestos) Regs 2016 standard for Class B, disposal by the contractor, air monitoring not mandatory. Access/scaffold and edge protection are NOT added separately because source-1's upper tiers expressly include 'special safety measures' for restricted access (avoid double count). Testing/survey excluded - scope assumes the soffit is already treated as ACM. QV CostBuilder holds NO asbestos removal rows anywhere (trades searched, and list_qv_sections for Asbestos/Removal/Hazardous returned nothing), so the main driver is sourced from published NZ vendor cost guidance rather than QV tender data - hence LOW confidence and a wide band. Undecided items that move the band: soffit area, asbestos type and condition (if friable/Class A, use the Ceilings & Walls $85-$500/m2 range and add mandatory air monitoring), access and height, containment extent, and disposal route/distance (rural transport can add to the removal rate). Confirm before converting to a tender figure; ring licensed removalists (AsbestosRNZ, PRO Environmental Services, Revolve Asbestos) and QV-priced rates for the scaffolding/replacement follow-on.

band.unit: NZD per m² of soffit area, GST exclusive
band.basis: Composite specialist removal rate $135–$300/m² (low = Chemcare large-area Auckland figure; high capped from the cited $500/m² small-area extreme for bonded board) plus $5–$20/m² QV-based mobile-scaffold access = $140–$320/m², mid ~$230/m². Priced on the stated assumption: bonded/Class B asbestos-cement soffit board, single storey, area 15–40 m², standard containment, disposal to a licensed facility, Auckland. If the soffit is friable, deteriorated or water-damaged (Class A), expect the upper half of the band or above. Below ~15 m² the job is minimum-charge driven ($800–$2,500 per job) and per-m² rates rise sharply. Confidence LOW: the main driver is a vendor-published web rate, not a QV rate; three NZ sources span roughly $25/m² to $500/m² once area effects are included.

band.unit: NZD per m² of soffit area, GST exclusive
band.basis: Market-rate band, not a certified price. Two distinct components added: (1) specialist Class B non-friable asbestos-cement soffit removal and disposal, all-in, $57–$130/m² GST-ex; (2) independent clearance/air-monitoring allowance, $3–$7/m² GST-ex. Total $60–$137/m², typical ~$100/m². Centre selected from the midpoint of the cited NZ removal range ($70–$150/m², mid ~$110 incl GST/divided to ex-GST ~$96) plus the clearance allowance. Priced on the assumption the soffit is confirmed ACM requiring licensed removal, non-friable Class B, single-storey-equivalent access within the Auckland metro (Auckland sits at the upper end of the national range — source-6 notes higher disposal transport, contractor demand and urgency premiums). Excludes replacement soffit (per scope), pre-removal testing/survey, scaffolding hire if two-storey/steep, and rush-booking premiums (source-7: rush carries a 20–50% premium). Confidence is LOW because: QV publishes no asbestos rate; the figures are removalist/consumer cost guides, not reviewed QV rows; area, friability, height/access, containment level and disposal distance are all undecided and each moves the rate materially; and small soffits attract a minimum-job loading that can push the effective per-m² rate well above this band.
